text: [**Occitan**](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Occitan_language) is a Romance language closely related to Catalan that’s sparsely concentrated in the South of France, most often found on street signs in big cities, and very rarely on [town entry signs](https://maps.app.goo.gl/J5Bj9ZSR2MfHAegg9). It can be divided into dialects, each using a slightly different word for street, all similar to Catalan “carrer”. For example, in Toulouse, you’ll find the Languedocian carrièra and in Avignon carriero, in the Provençal** **dialect.
Click [here](https://i.imgur.com/B8gX96p.png) for a more extensive infographic.
NOTE: The street sign designs pictured are also unique to the two cities respectively.
text_zh: [**奧克語**](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Occitan_language)是一種與加泰隆尼亞語密切相關的羅曼語族語言，稀疏地分佈在法國南部，最常出現在大城市的街道招牌上，極少數出現在[城鎮入口標誌](https://maps.app.goo.gl/J5Bj9ZSR2MfHAegg9)上。它可以分為多種方言，每種方言對街道的稱呼略有不同，但都與加泰隆尼亞語的「carrer」相似。例如，在土魯斯你會看到朗格多克方言的 carrièra，而在亞維農則會看到普羅旺斯** **方言的 carriero。
點擊[這裡](https://i.imgur.com/B8gX96p.png)查看更詳細的資訊圖表。
注意：圖中顯示的街道招牌設計也分別是這兩座城市特有的。

text: Lyon’s street signs feature four corner bolts and an **uninterrupted inner white border** that cuts a **notch** for the arrondissement and each bolt.
NOTE: Outside Lyon proper, the street sign will display the [name of the suburb](https://maps.app.goo.gl/gP3ngUUpUKf4Rqmz6) instead.
text_zh: 里昂的街道招牌特色是四個角落都有螺絲，且具有**不間斷的內側白色邊框**，該邊框在行政區編號和每個螺絲處都有一個**凹口**。
注意：在里昂市區外，街道招牌會顯示[郊區的名稱](https://maps.app.goo.gl/gP3ngUUpUKf4Rqmz6)來代替。

text: If you see a **blue** or **green** street sign shaped like an **arrow**, attached to a utility pole or street light, you are likely to be in the county of Szabolcs-Szatmár-Bereg.

NOTE: Blue arrow-shaped street signs can also be found in [Dunakeszi](https://www.google.com/maps/@47.6290186,19.1549932,3a,29.7y,151.87h,90.55t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1se_1iRMK0jnxi0R13E9x-8A!2e0!7i16384!8i8192), north of Budapest. However, those are attached to blue sign posts.
text_zh: 如果你看到形狀像**箭頭**的**藍色**或**綠色**路標，固定在電線桿或路燈上，你很可能位於索博爾奇-薩特馬爾-貝雷格州。
注意：藍色箭頭形狀的路標也可以在布達佩斯以北的[鄧納凱施](https://www.google.com/maps/@47.6290186,19.1549932,3a,29.7y,151.87h,90.55t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1se_1iRMK0jnxi0R13E9x-8A!2e0!7i16384!8i8192)找到。然而，那些是固定在藍色標誌桿上的。

text: This street sign is unique to **Brisbane **City Council.
text_zh: 這種路牌是**布里斯本 **市議會特有的。

text: This street sign is unique to **Gold Coast** City Council.
text_zh: 這種路牌是**黃金海岸**市議會特有的。

text: This street sign is unique to the City of **Sydney**.
text_zh: 這種路牌是**雪梨**市特有的。

text: Street name signs in Belgium are very diverse, and often unique to a city. Most common colours are **white **and **dark** **blue**. They often have the** town or city name** written on them.
NOTE: These signs often have variable designs, but most of them are fairly short and tall. In comparison, Dutch street signs are almost always much longer than they are tall.
text_zh: 比利時的街名牌非常多樣化，且通常為某個城市所獨有。最常見的顏色是**白色**和**深** **藍色**。它們上面通常寫有**城鎮或城市名稱**。
備註：這些標誌的設計往往不盡相同，但大多數都相當短而高。相比之下，荷蘭的路牌幾乎總是寬度遠大於高度。

text: Baarle-Hertog, located north-east of Antwerp, is composed of several exclaves and enclaves of Belgium and the Netherlands. You can often see the country's borders in this city (indicated by **small white crosses**). Street name signs tell you whether you are in Belgium or The Netherlands.
text_zh: 巴勒海托赫位於安特衛普東北方，由比利時和荷蘭的多個飛地與嵌入地組成。在這個城市裡你經常可以看到國界（由**白色小十字**標示）。街道路牌會告訴你你是在比利時還是荷蘭。

text: Bilingual street name signs with Croatian and **Italian** are typically found in Istria, especially in the western cities.
text_zh: 標示克羅埃西亞文與**義大利文**的雙語街道名稱標誌通常出現在伊斯特拉，尤其是西部城市。

text: The most common type of street sign in Czechia are **bright red** signs, which can either be wide and stuck on walls, or thin and attached to [signs posts](https://goo.gl/maps/ikgYSMAs1jAg8rqMA). Note that other street signs do occur in some areas, most notably in [Brno](https://www.google.com/maps/@49.1989638,16.6165572,3a,35y,97.05h,95.53t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1s4kmt2ZzZOxhdBnJR1Ge13A!2e0!7i16384!8i8192). Similarly designed [blue](https://www.google.com/maps/@50.2119242,15.8240056,3a,15y,292.91h,96.94t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1suOJ7x-GhmeTeCT9Pa6vWng!2e0!7i16384!8i8192) signs are also fairly common.

Furthermore, the Czech word for street is “ulice”, unlike most Slavic languages which use “ulica”. This word is usually omitted, but finding “ulice” on [street signs](https://goo.gl/maps/U6pq8zx1eJPVVHuq9) is still possible.
NOTE: [Slovakia](https://goo.gl/maps/CkdiggTX35tAuRZG8) typically uses white street signs with a red border and blue text.
text_zh: 捷克最常見的街道標誌是**亮紅色**標誌，可以是寬版並貼在牆上，或是窄版並固定在[標誌桿](https://goo.gl/maps/ikgYSMAs1jAg8rqMA)上。請注意，某些地區也會出現其他顏色的街道標誌，最明顯的是在[布爾諾](https://www.google.com/maps/@49.1989638,16.6165572,3a,35y,97.05h,95.53t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1s4kmt2ZzZOxhdBnJR1Ge13A!2e0!7i16384!8i8192)。類似設計的[藍色](https://www.google.com/maps/@50.2119242,15.8240056,3a,15y,292.91h,96.94t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1suOJ7x-GhmeTeCT9Pa6vWng!2e0!7i16384!8i8192)標誌也相當常見。
此外，捷克語中的「街道」是「ulice」，這與大多數使用「ulica」的斯拉夫語言不同。這個字通常會被省略，但在[街道標誌](https://goo.gl/maps/U6pq8zx1eJPVVHuq9)上還是找得到「ulice」。
注意：[斯洛伐克](https://goo.gl/maps/CkdiggTX35tAuRZG8)通常使用帶有紅邊和藍字白色街道標誌。

text: If you see a white street sign with **blue text** and a **red border**, the same as is typical for Slovakia, then you should be near the Slovak border.
text_zh: 如果你看到白底、配有**藍色文字**和**紅色邊框**的街道標示（這跟斯洛伐克的典型風格一樣），那麼你應該就在斯洛伐克邊境附近。

text: Street name signs in Santo Domingo often contain the letters **“ADN”**, a reference to the Distrito Nacional, which the city is located in.
text_zh: 聖多明哥的路名標牌通常包含字母 **“ADN”**，這是該市所在國家特區（Distrito Nacional）的縮寫。

text: This style of **blue street sign **with white text is unique to the cities of Seinäjoki and [Isokyrö](https://goo.gl/maps/SdmNDAwLzkXPyN6z6) southeast of Vaasa.
text_zh: 這種帶有白字的**藍色路標**風格是瓦薩東南方的塞伊奈約基和[伊索屈勒](https://goo.gl/maps/SdmNDAwLzkXPyN6z6)兩市所特有的。

text: The city of Järvenpää uses street signs with this **blue-**and-**grey **[coat of arms](https://fi.wikipedia.org/wiki/J%C3%A4rvenp%C3%A4%C3%A4n_vaakuna#/media/Tiedosto:Jarvenpaa.vaakuna.svg) in the top-left corner. The [neighbourhood](https://media.discordapp.net/attachments/1045971390202925086/1063500707099070514/Jarvenpaan_Alueet.png) name is also written above the street name.
NOTE: If you see a street sign with a coat of arms not mentioned in this guide, you should be near Kerava or Lahti.
text_zh: 耶爾文佩市使用左上角帶有這個**藍**灰相間[市徽](https://fi.wikipedia.org/wiki/J%C3%A4rvenp%C3%A4%C3%A4n_vaakuna#/media/Tiedosto:Jarvenpaa.vaakuna.svg)的路標。[鄰里](https://media.discordapp.net/attachments/1045971390202925086/1063500707099070514/Jarvenpaan_Alueet.png)名稱也寫在街道名稱的上方。
注意：如果你看到的街牌上有本指南未提及的市徽，你應該就在凱拉瓦或拉赫蒂附近。

text: If you see a street sign with a **thick metal frame** around it, you are very likely to be in the **western** parts of the country.
text_zh: 如果你看到路標周圍有**厚金屬框**，你非常有可能身處該國的**西部**地區。

text: Most street name signs in Jersey are adorned with the **coat of arms** of the parish in which they are located.
_You can click on the graphic to enlarge it._
text_zh: 澤西島的大多數路名標誌都裝飾有所屬教區的**紋章**。
_你可以點擊圖片將其放大。_

text: While rarely possible, being able to read the letters under a QR code on a street sign will give you the region.
text_zh: 雖然極少數情況下可行，但如果能讀懂路牌上 QR 碼下方的字母，就能知道所在的地區。

text: **Yellow street name signs** with a black outline are specific to the state of Johor.
NOTE: This **arrow-shaped** street sign, regardless of its colour, is exclusive to Malaysia.
NOTE: Yellow signs are also found in southern [Negeri Sembilan](https://maps.app.goo.gl/HG89SePzMd5WWheo6), however only the tip of the arrow will be black.
text_zh: 帶有黑色外框的**黃色路名標誌**是柔佛州特有的。
NOTE: 這個**箭頭形狀**的路標，無論其顏色為何，都是馬來西亞特有的。
NOTE: 黃色標誌也見於[森美蘭](https://maps.app.goo.gl/HG89SePzMd5WWheo6)南部，不過只有箭頭的尖端是黑色的。

text: The Maltese word for street is “**triq**”, which can be seen on almost every street sign.
text_zh: 馬爾他語的街道是「**triq**」，幾乎可以在每一個路名牌上看到。

text: Saransk has an exclusive circular street sign design with the street name being written in up to **4 different languages**.
text_zh: 薩蘭斯克擁有獨特的圓形路標設計，路標上的街道名稱最多以 **4 種不同的語言**書寫。

text: All street name signs in Singapore follow this **unique format**. They are green, with rounded edges and a distinct white font.
text_zh: 新加坡所有的街道名稱標誌都遵循這種**獨特的格式**。它們是綠色的，邊緣圓潤，並採用獨特的白色字體。

text: The city of Bilbao uses this unique street sign, with a very **elaborately decorated frame**. It is not found anywhere else in Spain.
text_zh: 畢爾巴鄂（Bilbao）市使用這種獨特的街頭標誌，具有非常 **裝飾繁複的邊框**。這在西班牙其他任何地方都找不到。

text: These **blue** street name signs, with a narrow **metal border**, are specific to Dubai.
text_zh: 這些帶有狹窄**金屬邊框**的**藍色**路名標誌是杜拜特有的。

text: Street name signs in Aberdeen and Aberdeenshire typically feature a simple **blue background** with white lettering.
NOTE: Central Aberdeen uses a different, [black-and-yellow](https://maps.app.goo.gl/dpw9AUQ1e6ieL5U19) design.
text_zh: 亞伯丁（Aberdeen）與亞伯丁郡（Aberdeenshire）的街名標誌通常採用簡單的**藍色背景**搭配白色字體。
注意：阿伯丁市中心採用不同的[黑黃相間](https://maps.app.goo.gl/dpw9AUQ1e6ieL5U19)設計。

intro.lead: 路名牌的形式與街道用字直接指向語言區
body: 看牌子的形狀與掛法，更重要的是街道的通用字：calle、rue、straat、katu、gatan、rruga、triq 這些字各自對應到明確的語言區，比整條街名更好記。
地名後綴同樣有用，例如波蘭的 -owo、德語區的 -weiler、挪威的 -veien。
